description: Aerial or satellite imagery displaying a rugged, mountainous landscape, primarily covered in light beige and off-white tones indicative of sparsely vegetated land or bare soil. A distinctive reddish-pink area with irregular, curvilinear boundaries is prominent in the lower-left, extending upwards and to the right, contrasting sharply with the lighter surrounding terrain. This reddish-pink feature could represent distinct soil composition, specific vegetation types, or potentially burnt areas, corresponding to CLMS (Copernicus Land Monitoring Service) nomenclature class 6.3.2 (Burnt areas). The image depicts "Sparsely vegetated areas in the foreground Nipfjället, Sweden." Credit: S. Kirppu.
